title: 2027 Yale School of Art Virtual Visit
summary: Visual identity for the Yale School of Art 2027 MFA Admission Virtual Visit.
credits:
Design: Junyeol Baek
Typeface: Protoform by [Sulki & Min](https://sulki-min.com/)
Visual Identity Reference: Yale School of Art website by [Other Means](https://othermeans.us/)
Client: Yale School of Art
description: Set in Protoform, the typeface by Sulki & Min, visiting lecturers in Graphic Design in September 2026, and drawn from Other Means' visual identity for the new Yale School of Art website, launched in August 2026. The letters are taken apart and rebuilt piece by piece, after the school's Crown Building, under construction for the next four years.
